thread:
nina: Heads up — launching a small flight next week to sync paid search + retargeting with the webinar push. Goal: drive qualified signups for Mar 10 webinar and test light bid tweaks. Quick plan below.
ravi: love it. prioritize the webinar audience with higher bids?
sam: yes, let's stack higher bids on 'webinar intent' keywords and lower bids on broader terms. thinking +20% / -25%. keep spend small.
elaine: creative refresh: 2 new CTAs that call out "Mar 10 webinar" and a short 1-line benefit. assets in Ads folder (ads/webinar_mar10).
nina: tagging/UTMs: use utm_campaign=webinar_mar10_paid, utm_exp=webinar_bid_surg. also append ?promo=web10 so Landing can detect.
sam: routing: strong intent signups (form_score >= 85 or using promo code web10) => route to SDR_ws_queue immediate. others => nurture.
mkt-ops-bot: Draft campaigns created: search-webinar-mar10-1842 (paused), retarget-webinar-mar10-1842 (paused). Use `/launch search-webinar-mar10-1842 --go` to start.
ravi: success metrics: target CPL <= $30 and QA rate >= 25% (qualified per SDR). min sample 200 clicks per channel. rollback if CPL > $45 or webinar CTR drops >15%.
elaine: note on creative: headlines are short for speaker credibility + CTA. examples: "Join Mar 10: Reducing LLM inference cost 30%" and "Live demo + benchmark walk-through".
sam: pacing rule I'll add to avoid front-loading: 
```
if hourly_spend > daily_budget * 0.12:
  reduce_bids(10%)
```

nina: can we also set an audience exclusion so recent converters (last 30d) don't see the webinars ads?
ravi: yes — exclude purchase and demo converters.
mkt-ops-bot: Ads manager flags set: exclude_list=converters_30d, utm_defaults applied.
elaine: I'll prepare the short webinar landing variant that shows speaker + time and quick FAQ. No A/B tests during this small flight.
sam: timeline: prep by Thu, review Fri, launch Mon 9am PT. daily snapshot in #marketing-ops at 10am PT.
nina: tagging for analytics: add experiment label webinar_bid_surg_1842 on every ad and GA event 'webinar_signup_paid'.
ravi: sounds good. thanks team — keep spend conservative. :speaker: :rocket:
elaine: noted — sharing final checklist tonight.
